JournalCues.Title: Journal Cues
JournalCues.Dialog.DeletePrompt: Delete this cue from the scene?
JournalCues.Empty.NoActions: No actions in this cue yet.
JournalCues.Empty.NoCues: No cues stored on this scene yet.
JournalCues.Empty.NoSelection: Select a cue, or create a new one.
JournalCues.Fields.Name: Name
JournalCues.Hints.DefaultDelay: Used after actions that do not set their own delay.
JournalCues.Hints.LoopLimit: Use 0 for unlimited repeats until stopped.
JournalCues.Hints.PlaybackOrigin: Recorded start makes repeatable scene beats. Current placement replays token movement relative to where the token is now.
JournalCues.Help.Actions.Label: Supported actions
JournalCues.Help.Actions.Text: Tokens, doors, walls, tiles, lights, sounds, regions, pings, chat messages, macros, roll tables, playlists, D&D5e activities, camera, images, audio, and portraits.
JournalCues.Help.Doors.Label: Doors
JournalCues.Help.Doors.Text: autoDoors allows passable doors to open during movement. closeDoors restores doors opened by that movement step.
JournalCues.Help.Links.Label: Journal links
JournalCues.Help.Links.Text: Use @Cue[cue-id]{Visible Text} in a journal entry.
JournalCues.Help.Loops.Label: Loops
JournalCues.Help.Loops.Text: Enable Loop in the selected cue. A limit of 0 repeats until stopped.
JournalCues.Help.Movement.Label: Movement
JournalCues.Help.Movement.Text: Recorded token movement replays recorded steps directly. Set autoPath: true in JSON only when you want Journal Cues to calculate a route around walls.
JournalCues.Help.Playback.Label: Playback
JournalCues.Help.Playback.Text: Play replays actions in order. Restore returns to the recorded starting state.
JournalCues.Help.Recording.Label: Recording
JournalCues.Help.Recording.Text: Select a cue, click Start Recording, perform scene actions, then Stop or Cancel.
JournalCues.Options.EnableLoop: Replay this cue in a loop
Default pause in milliseconds after each Journal Cue action when the action does not set its own delay.
